name: Spectra
author: Radius Media
description: Audio spectrum for the Omarchy bar. Bars, dots, wave or filled area; one shared cava capture across every monitor that suspends itself when nothing is playing.

schema.label: Style
schema.description: Bars are classic rectangles, Dots light a ladder of cells, Wave draws the spectrum as a line, Area fills underneath it.

schema.label: Direction
schema.description: Bottom grows up from the baseline, Mirror grows out from the centre line, Top hangs down from the ceiling.

schema.label: Colour
schema.description: Accent, Foreground and Muted are flat theme colours. Gradient fades quiet bands toward muted. Spectrum sweeps hue across the bands, anchored on your accent.

schema.label: Bands
schema.description: How many frequency bands to draw.

schema.label: Bar width
schema.description: Width of a single bar in logical pixels.

schema.label: Gap
schema.description: Space between bars in logical pixels.

schema.label: Height (%)
schema.description: How much of the bar's height the spectrum is allowed to use.

schema.label: Sensitivity (%)
schema.description: Scales the incoming levels. Above 100 makes quiet material reach higher.

schema.label: Punch (%)
schema.description: Bends the level curve. 100 is linear; higher values lift quiet passages off the baseline without clipping loud ones.

schema.label: Band smoothing (%)
schema.description: Spreads each peak into its neighbours. 0 shows raw FFT bins, which look spiky; higher values read more like music.

schema.label: Attack
schema.description: How fast a band rises to a transient.

schema.label: Release
schema.description: How slowly a band sinks back afterwards.

schema.label: Peak hold
schema.description: Leave a falling cap at each band's most recent peak.

schema.label: Fold away when silent
schema.description: Collapse the widget to nothing after a couple of seconds of silence.

schema.label: Suspend capture when idle
schema.description: Stop the cava process entirely while nothing is routed to an output. Turn off if you want the capture pinned on.

schema.label: Capture framerate
schema.description: How often cava reports new levels. Rendering is frame-smoothed regardless.
